kebab_example: aliyun selectdb describe-db-instances --resource-group-id rg-4690g379290000 --db-instance-ids selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --db-instance-status ACTIVATION --db-instance-description New_instance_test --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=testValue Key=testKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，多个实例ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

CREATING: The instance is being created.

ACTIVATION: The instance is running.

RESOURCE_CHANGING: The instance is being upgraded or downgraded.

ORDER_PREPARING: The order is being confirmed.

READONLY_RESOURCE_CHANGING: The instance configuration is being changed, and the instance is write-locked.

DELETING: The instance is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
实例的状态，取值说明：
CREATING：创建中。

ACTIVATION：运行中。

RESOURCE_CHANGING：变配中。

ORDER_PREPARING：订单确认中。

READONLY_RESOURCE_CHANGING：资源变配中（实例写入锁定）。

DELETING：删除中
parameters.name: db_instance_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of tags of instances
parameters.name: tag
